capabilities: Log in to Flomo from Obsidian without copying tokens
Fetch all Flomo memos and convert them to Markdown files
Organize memos into folders matching the Flomo tag hierarchy
Detect and apply new, updated, and deleted memos incrementally
Convert HTML rich text to Markdown with YAML frontmatter
disambiguation: One-way import from Flomo into the vault; it does not push Obsidian edits back to Flomo.
extras: Uses Flomo's unofficial internal API and may break if Flomo changes it; auto-login is desktop-only (Electron) and the plugin does not work on mobile; community plugin listing marked 'coming soon', so manual install is currently the path; token may expire and require re-login.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull Flomo memos, and Flomo has no official integration, so users must copy tokens and export content manually.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses Flomo's internal web API (the same endpoints used by the Flomo web app).

summary: Syncs Flomo memos into the vault as Markdown files with tag-based folders, auto-login, and incremental updates.
